verdict.rationale: Browserbase is an API-driven platform, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair ask, but the probe found no spec: every candidate path (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returned 404. The llms.txt file and the SDK docs are not machine-readable API specs, and nothing else in the pack documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent file.
